The year '''1057 BBY before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Births==
*The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Xelian]] gives birth to her son [[Daiman]].<ref name="DaimanBirthDate">Page 35 of the novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] mentions that Daiman was born 25 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of the book. As the [[StarWars.com]] article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], this places Daiman's birth in 1057 BBY.</ref>
